shots.name: close-any-open-dialog
shots.js: (() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); if (!d) return 'no dialog'; const b = [...d.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => /close/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label') || '') || x.textContent.trim() === '×'); if (b) { b.click(); return 'closed via button' } document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true })); return 'sent Escape' })()

shots.name: go-to-chat
shots.check: document.body.innerText.includes('No chats yet') ? 'chat list is empty' : 'CHATS PRESENT'
